Decoded by Galvor, Issue #18: The Brief Is the Filter. Why 66% of Creator Rejections Came Down to One Line

Decoded #4 showed that clean creator numbers don't predict fit. Three months of Galvor Scout checks show where fit is actually decided: in the brief. Most creators we turned down missed a must-have the brand had written down. This issue is about writing must-haves that do the filtering for you.

Subscribe to get it every Wednesday.
notes: Outline planned 18 Nov 2026 (why now: Brands are briefing creators for March launches and summer; proof season continues with how Galvor Scout is being used, three months after its November launch and Decoded #4.). Posted from the Galvor page. Write with Decoded → Draft with AI, then fill every [DATA NEEDED].

## How we did this

Galvor's data needed for this issue:
- 8,673 creator checks, Aug to early Nov 2026 (Decoded #4, facts bank)
- 66% of 2,586 creators turned down missed a stated must-have (facts bank)
- 38% of 1,428 creators whose content looked like a strong fit were moved down on engagement (facts bank)
- 62% of 1,018 top-engagement creators still weren't right for the brief (facts bank)
